description: Lightning bolt pools (the Incubus's bolts). A bolt is a chain of "segments" straight segments of "step" length (Q12 metres). A spawner throws a bolt from a point toward a target; its walker moves the aim along a path (Seek: straight at the target until within half a step; Sweep: walk.sweep_steps steps toward it; Lob: up over the middle of the way, down near the target, then to the ground there; Waypoint: to one of the first walk.waypoint_count waypoints, then down below the ground line; Drift, Roam, Wander: see walk.*) and each segment turns toward the aim by at most "turn" (Q12 angle, 4096 = full turn; pitch by half of it). A bolt grows from its start to its end in half its life (grow_rate segments per half life) and withers from the start in the other half. Each visible segment is drawn as a ribbon: a textured quad between the crosses of two segments (half width step * width / 4096), twisted by a roll of twist[0]..twist[1] per segment; a segment starts at "color" and loses "fade" every frame it is drawn. A segment within hit.radius_sq (Q8 squared, the squares summed >> 4) of Harry's chest hurts him (the owner's damage, halved for each earlier hit within hit.streak_window), flashes the fire pool there, plays the owner's hit sounds and ends the bolt. head_burst: a fire burst at the head once the bolt is fully grown. end_bolt: when the bolt ends, that spawner throws a bolt from its head to the owner's bone. scatter: the start is that far from the point in a random direction and the bolt aims back at it. sounds: slots with a minimum gap (interval + a roll of 0..interval/8, Q12 seconds; first_gap after the map loads). lead: how far the boss leads its aim by Harry's movement (Q12 gain per second; easy and other difficulties). Every key is checked. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.

BossBolts.description: map7_s03: the Incubus fights and the endings (bound through sh.entity.boss_fx_* and the ending scenes). Numbers, sound table and waypoints from the original MAP7_S03.BIN.
